summary.text: One of the three Moirai; Hesiod makes her first a fatherless daughter of Nyx and later a daughter of Zeus and Themis.
One of the three Fates born to Zeus and Themis.
One of the three Parcae, daughter of Night and Erebus, who foretold that the newborn Meleager would be brave.

story.text: Hesiod first names Lachesis among the ruthless Fates born by Nyx without a father. With Clotho and Atropos she assigns good and evil at birth and punishes transgression among mortals and gods.
The Theogony later gives Lachesis a different family, making her a daughter of Zeus and bright Themis and a sister of the Horae.
Apollodorus also lists Lachesis among the Fates born to Zeus and Themis.
Hyginus calls the three Parcae children of Night and Erebus. When they appeared at Meleager's birth, Lachesis announced that the infant would be brave.
